messages:
support-bot: ALERT: spike observed on hosted /v1/generate (us-east-1). Multiple tenants reporting 5xx + timeouts. Primary symptom: repeated 'request queue depth exceeded' in gateway logs. sample req_id=rcp-abc123, rate ~110-140 rps from tenant=paperly :rotating_light:

maria: seeing the same on dashboards — p95 latency jumped from 400ms -> 2.5s, p99 ~18s, 5xx rate +3.8% in the last 7m. Continuous-batcher backlog length is climbing on several hosts.

ajay: digging into traces now. initial read: lots of requests hitting gateway but being dropped with `429/5xx queue depth exceeded` before enqueue. Can anyone paste the offending logs + request header sample?

sophie: pasted a snippet from the gateway (sanitized):
```
2026-03-18T09:12:07Z gateway service=ingress req=rcp-abc123 tenant=paperly result=enqueue_failed reason="queue_depth_exceeded" depth=256 max=256
2026-03-18T09:12:07Z gateway service=ingress req=rcp-def456 tenant=paperly result=timeout reason="batcher_backlog" backlog_ms=12000
```

ajay: thanks. looks like continuous-batching warmup + a hotspot from a client. paperly is sending many small requests with long tails; kv-cache miss rate is high so batching isn't amortizing.

nate (eng-oncall): any recent config pushes to gateway or batcher? did we change default queue.depth?

kyle: no infra config pushes in the last 24h to prod. however we did roll a model variant for hosted small-latency models at 08:50 which changed allocation on a subset of pools. deploy-bot shows rollout succeeded.

maria: correlation: rollout at 08:50, metrics spike ~09:05. could be redistribution causing temporary KV cache coldness -> larger batch and backlog.

ajay: repro attempt: you can reproduce a similar failure locally with this script (simulated client):
```
for i in {1..500}; do
  curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood-hosted/v1/generate
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
    -H "X-Tenant-ID: paperly"
    -d '{"prompt":"short","max_tokens":8}' &
done
wait
```
Expect a subset to 5xx with queue depth messages if you hit the same pool.

sophie: billing-bot shows no failed billing events for paperly in the last hour, so this looks infra (not billing/auth). auth tokens validated fine in logs.

nate (eng-oncall): mitigation suggestions: (1) immediate: rate-limit tenant paperly to 50 rps at the gateway to reduce enqueue pressure; (2) increase `queue.depth.max` on affected pools from 256 -> 512 temporarily; (3) enable fallback routing to a different pool (dedicated) for paperly traffic. Thoughts?

kyle: agree. also enable KV-cache prewarm for the newly rolled variant to reduce cold misses. Will open a controlled change for queue depth -> 512 with a 10m rollback.

maria: adding a canary rule: if p99 > 5s in next 10m, roll back the variant.

ajay: I'll run the repro load in staging to confirm behavior before we change prod. also collecting flamegraphs and batcher queue histograms.

sophie: support-bot: updated: created support ticket ST-9832 for affected customers (paperly + 2 others). Notifying Customer Success for high-touch outreach.

billing-bot: note: paperly has a recently exhausted promo credit but billing attempts are not failing auth; unrelated but CS should know.

nate (eng-oncall): action items: kyle -> apply queue depth bump (in 2m), ajay -> perform staging repro + gather traces, maria -> monitor SLO and be ready to rollback variant, sophie -> CS notification and customer comms. I'll keep the incident channel open. :thumbsup:

kyle: starting change now. pushing queue.depth.max=512 to pool-id=hosted-small-3 (rolling 3 hosts) — will report back on success/failure.

maria: after kyle change, p95 down to 600ms within ~90s, p99 now ~3.2s, 5xx rate decreasing. Looks promising.

ajay: repro in staging reproduced the queue depth fail; with prewarm + larger queue the failure rate drops ~90%. I have uploaded traces to /internal/traces/rcp-20260318 (link sent in DM).

sophie: CS updated customers with interim mitigation and ETA for full fix (KV prewarm + variant rollback if needed).

nate (eng-oncall): closing loop: will keep monitoring for 2h, if stable convert to post-incident follow-up with root cause (variant rollout + KV coldness causing batching backlog). Assigning postmortem to ajay + kyle + maria.

support-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation applied (queue depth increased, tenant throttled). follow-up: postmortem due in 72h.
